blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multi-modal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench , a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects, including S emantics, Qu ality, A uthenticity, and Re sponsibility . SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AIGIs sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models ( e.g. , Gemini-3-Pro) already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.
blocks.zh: 随着文字到形象(T2I)生成的迅速推进,强力评价变得至关重要但具有挑战性,因为传统度量衡无法捕捉到精细的纹理和基因化文物. 虽然大型多模式模型越来越多地被作为评价者采用,但现有基准通常孤立地研究语义理解、质量感知和真实性识别,同时在很大程度上忽略了责任检测。 这就在统一和全面的验证方面留下了一个空白。 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了SQUARE-Bench(SQUARE-Bench)这一综合基准,它系统地评价了LMM作为AI生成的图像的评价者的能力,涉及四个方面,包括S语义、Qu ality、A 校正性和Re sponsibility。 SQUARE-Bench采用了由38个子元组成的颗粒分类法,用于评价从22个不同模型中取样的近10K个AIGI,从遗产到最先进的发电机,并辅之以超过3K个真实世界的图像。 图片以曲解的问答对作注释. 对23个LMM的广泛实验表明,顶级专利模型(如双子座-3-Pro)已经超过了个人专家的基准。 然而,模型之间的性能差距仍然很大,在细微推论和具体领域稳健性方面存在显著差距。 除了制定基准外,我们还对LMM制导的迭代编辑进行概念证明研究,其中针对维度的LMM向固定图像编辑提供诊断反馈. 由此产生的制导系统在语义、真实性和责任方面有选择地改进,同时表现出一贯的视觉质量权衡。 SQUARE-Bench既可作为诊断工具,用于描述LMM评价能力,也用于研究其在T2I生成改进中的用途. 基准和数据集将在公布后公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The field of artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) has advanced rapidly, largely driven by the development of generative models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) . Given a natural language prompt, modern text-to-image (T2I) models can now synthesize high-fidelity and semantically relevant images, enabling broad applications in creative industries, design, and digital entertainment ( Kolors Team and Kuaishou Technology, 2025 ; Google, 2025 ) . Despite these remarkable advances, current models still exhibit notable limitations, they frequently suffer from text-image misalignment, lack fine-grained fidelity, and occasionally produce outputs that violate commonsense physics, aesthetic standards, or safety boundaries. Consequently, robust evaluation mechanisms are indispensable, not only for benchmarking progress but also for constructing high-quality reward models to steer T2I generation through reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2024a ; Peters and Schaal, 2007 ) .
blocks.zh: 人工智能生成内容领域(AIGC)进展迅速,主要受基因模型发展驱动(Rombach等人,2022年;Saharia等人,2022年). 鉴于自然语言的迅速性,现代的文本对图像(T2I)模型现在能够合成高真实度和精密相关的图像,从而能够在创意产业,设计和数字娱乐中广泛应用(Kolors Team和Kuaishou Technology,2025;Google,2025). 尽管取得了这些显著的进步,但目前的模型仍然显示出显著的局限性,它们经常受到文本图像错位,缺乏精细的忠诚度,偶尔会产生违反常识物理,美学标准或安全界限的输出. 因此,强有力的评价机制是不可或缺的,不仅对于衡量进展,而且对于建立高质量奖励模式,通过强化从人类反馈(RLHF)中学习来指导T2I的生成,都是不可或缺的(徐等人,2023年;刘等人,2025年a; 徐等人,2024a;彼得斯和沙尔,2007.).

blocks.en: Evaluating AI-generated images (AIGIs) is a multifaceted challenge. Traditional metrics generally fail to meet the requirements. Conventional image quality assessment (IQA) methods cannot discern generative artifacts ( e.g. , distorted limbs), while CLIP-based scores ( Radford et al., 2021 ) often fail to capture compositional nuances and human aesthetic preferences ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . To address this, the research community has increasingly explored utilizing large multi-modal models (LMMs) as evaluators, leveraging their human-like reasoning and interpretability ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) . Although recent LMM-based metrics demonstrate promise via high correlation (SRCC/PLCC) with human judgments, these aggregated scores function as “black boxes”—they validate that an LMM works, but fail to reveal why it works or where it fails.
blocks.zh: 评估AI生成的图像是一个多方面的挑战。 传统的衡量标准一般达不到要求。 常规图像质量评估方法无法辨别基因文物(如扭曲的四肢),而基于CLIP的分数(拉德福德等人,2021年)往往无法捕捉到构成上的细微差别和人类审美偏好(Wang等人,2025年b). 为解决这一问题,研究界越来越多地探索利用大型多式联运模式(LMMs)作为评估者,利用其人性的推理和解释能力(Hu等人,2023年;Lin等人,2024年)。 虽然最近基于LMM的衡量标准通过与人类判断的高相关性(SRCC/PLCC)显示出了希望,但这些总分作为 " 黑盒 " 发挥作用——它们证实LMM是有效的,但未能揭示它为什么起作用或在哪里失败。

blocks.en: Therefore, beyond using LMMs as scoring tools, it is necessary to systematically diagnose their own capabilities and failure modes as AIGI evaluators. However, existing benchmarks exhibit significant limitations. Previous works like A-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) and Q-Bench + ( Zhang et al., 2024c ) predominantly focus on semantic understanding and quality perception . In parallel, FakeBench ( Li et al., 2025b ) and LOKI ( Ye et al., 2024b ) solely target authenticity (synthetic detection). As a result, critical aspects such as responsibility remain insufficiently explored. More importantly, existing benchmarks lack a unified evaluation framework that comprehensively explores the capabilities of LMMs for AIGI assessment, while also failing to provide a sufficiently fine-grained taxonomy for disentangling complex and heterogeneous evaluation tasks.
blocks.zh: 因此,除了使用LMM作为评分工具外,还必须作为AIGI评价员系统诊断自己的能力和故障模式. 然而,现有基准显示出很大的局限性。 之前的作品如A-Bench(张等,2024b)和Q-Bench +(张等,2024c)主要侧重于语义理解和质量感知. 同时,Fake Bench(Li等人,2025年b)和LOKI(Ye等人,2024年b)完全瞄准真实性(合成检测). 因此,责任等关键方面仍未得到充分探讨。 更重要的是,现有基准缺乏一个统一的评价框架,无法全面探讨LMM评估AIGI的能力,同时也未能提供足够精细的分类方法,用于分散复杂和多样的评价任务。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench , a benchmark that comprehensively investigates the capabilities of LMMs in AIGI evaluation. As illustrated in Figure 1, SQUARE-Bench distinguishes itself through the following key contributions:
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了SQUARE-Bench,这是在AIGI评价中全面调查LMM能力的基准. 如图1所示,SQUARE-Bench通过下列主要贡献而有所区别:

blocks.en:
• Unified taxonomy pioneering responsibility: We introduce the first comprehensive AIGI evaluation benchmark spanning four fundamental aspects, i.e. , S emantics , Qu ality , A uthenticity , and Re sponsibility (across 38 sub-dimensions). By systematically integrating the responsibility aspect, SQUARE-Bench addresses a critical blind spot in prior frameworks, ensuring a holistic audit of safety and ethical alignment. • Large-scale hybrid dataset: We collect nearly 10,000 curated AIGIs from 22 diverse T2I models and over 3,000 real-world images. Moving beyond vague scoring, we employ an expert-driven construction and multi-expert review pipeline to produce approximately 18,000 descriptive, scenario-specific question-answer (QA) pairs. • Tailored evaluation tasks: Beyond standard QA formats, SQUARE-Bench incorporates specialized designs for distinct sub-dimensions, such as Binary Judgments for authenticity and multi-image reasoning for social fairness , enabling a rigorous assessment of complex LMM reasoning. • Innovative dual-answer mechanism: To bridge generative intent and visual perception, we introduce a “one Question, two Answers” design. For each query, Answer 1 strictly reflects the actual visual content (evaluating pure LMM perception), while Answer 2 describes the expected prompt outcome (establishing a baseline for T2I generation capabilities). In this work, we utilize SQUARE-Bench to extensively investigate the evaluation capabilities of 23 LMMs (20 open-source and 3 proprietary), offering a granular comparison against human performance.
From the results where top-tier models surpass the human baseline, we derive a pivotal conclusion:
blocks.zh:
• 统一的分类先驱责任: 我们采用第一个全面的AIGI评价基准,涵盖四个基本方面,即S语义、Qu ality、A 假说和Re sponsibility(共38个子词)。 通过系统地整合责任方面,SQUARE-Bench解决了以前框架中一个关键的盲点,确保对安全和道德协调进行全面审计。 • 大型混合数据集: 我们从22个不同的T2I模型和3000多幅真实世界的图像中收集了近10000张AIGI。 我们超越了模糊的评分,采用了由专家驱动的施工和多专家审查管道,产生了约18 000个描述性的、针对具体情况的对答。 • 有针对性的评价任务: 除了标准的QAARE-Bench格式外,SQUARE-Bench还包含了针对不同子特性的专门设计,如关于真实性的二进制判断和社会公平性的多图像推理,从而能够对复杂的LMM推理进行严格的评估. • 创新双答机制: 为了沟通遗传意图和视觉感知,我们采用了“一个问题,两个答案”的设计。 对于每个查询,回答1严格地反映了实际的视觉内容(评价纯LMM感知),而回答2则描述了预期的即时结果(为T2I生成能力建立基线). 在这项工作中,我们利用SQUARE-Bench广泛调查23个LMM(20个开源和3个专有)的评价能力,提供与人类性能的颗粒比较.
从顶级模型超过人类基线的结果中,我们得出一个关键的结论:

blocks.en: Unified taxonomy pioneering responsibility: We introduce the first comprehensive AIGI evaluation benchmark spanning four fundamental aspects, i.e. , S emantics , Qu ality , A uthenticity , and Re sponsibility (across 38 sub-dimensions). By systematically integrating the responsibility aspect, SQUARE-Bench addresses a critical blind spot in prior frameworks, ensuring a holistic audit of safety and ethical alignment.

For each query, Answer 1 strictly reflects the actual visual content (evaluating pure LMM perception), while Answer 2 describes the expected prompt outcome (establishing a baseline for T2I generation capabilities).

blocks.en: Top LMMs are evolving into expert-level AIGI evaluators that already outperform the individual human expert baseline, yet the performance gap between models remains significant.
blocks.zh: 顶级最低管理指标正在演变成专家级的AIGI评价人员,这些评价人员已经超过了个人专家基线,但模型之间的性能差距仍然很大。

blocks.en:
Gemini-3-Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2025a ) achieves the highest observed overall accuracy, exceeding the best individual expert among the five evaluators by approximately eight percentage points. However, this excellence is not ubiquitous; the majority of models cluster around 60% accuracy, indicating that the average capability remains significantly under-optimized.
Meanwhile, our T2I baseline reveals a severe generative bottleneck with a mere 26.72% overall success rate, exposing a critical gap between semantic texture synthesis and physical realism (scoring near 0% on authenticity). Furthermore, performance varies substantially across sub-dimensions, and open-source models occasionally outperform proprietary models, highlighting the diagnostic value of SQUARE-Bench for identifying model-specific strengths and weaknesses.
blocks.zh:
双子座-3-Pro(Google DeepMind,2025a)的观测总体准确度最高,超过5名评价员中最佳个人专家约8个百分点. 然而,这一优异之处并非无所不在;大多数模型组合的精度约为60%,表明平均能力仍然严重不足。
与此同时,我们的T2I基线揭示出一个严重的基因瓶颈,总体成功率只有26.72%,暴露了语义纹理合成和物理现实主义之间的关键差距(在真实性上得分接近0%). 此外,各小单元的性能也大不相同,开放源码模型偶尔会超越专有模型,突出SQUARE-Bench的诊断价值,以识别模型特有的优点和弱点。

blocks.en: To examine whether fine-grained LMM diagnoses can support post-generation refinement, we instantiate an LMM-guided iterative editing loop. We pair dimension-specific LMM guides with two fixed image editors, Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025a ) and Step1X-Edit-v1p2 ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , and compare original images, single-pass edits, and guided iterative edits using aspect-specific evaluation metrics. This auxiliary experiment examines the practical role of LMM guidance and identifies where iterative correction helps or harms post-generation refinement. Overall, SQUARE-Bench provides granular evidence for model diagnosis and optimization and serves as a standardized reference for selecting LMM evaluators for different aspects of AI-generated images.
blocks.zh: 为了检查精细的LMM诊断能否支持生成后的精细化,我们即时使用LMM制导的迭代编辑循环. 我们用两个固定的图像编辑器(Quen-Image-Edit(Wu等人,2025a)和Step1X-Edit-v1p2(Liu等人,2025b))来配对特定维度的LMM指南,并比较原始图像,单路编辑,以及用特定方面评价度量法来指导迭代编辑. 这一辅助实验研究了LMM指导的实际作用,并确定了迭代校正在哪些方面有助于或不利于生成后的完善. 总体而言,SQUARE-Bench为模型诊断和优化提供了颗粒性证据,并作为一个标准参考,用于为AI生成图像的不同方面选择LMM评价者.

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Evaluation benchmarks play a pivotal role in advancing the development of large multimodal models (LMMs). Previous benchmarks have evolved from task-specific evaluations like COCO Caption ( Chen et al., 2015 ) and GQA ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) to comprehensive suites such as MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , and MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , which primarily focus on assessing the broad and sophisticated reasoning capabilities of LMMs on natural images. More recently, as shown in Table 1 , specific benchmarks have emerged to evaluate LMMs in the domain of AI-generated images (AIGIs). Specifically, Q-Bench + ( Zhang et al., 2024c ) assesses low-level visual quality; A-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) targets semantic understanding and quality perception; while datasets like FakeBench ( Li et al., 2025b ) , LOKI ( Ye et al., 2024b ) , FakeClue ( Wen et al., 2025 ) , and DFbench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) concentrate on the authenticity aspect ( i.e. , synthetic detection). Despite these efforts, existing AIGI-oriented benchmarks still tend to evaluate different aspects in isolation and a systematic benchmark for AIGI evaluation remains absent. Existing works notably neglect the critical aspect of responsibility and rely predominantly on outdated T2I models ( e.g. , DALL-E 2 ( Ramesh et al., 2022 ) and SDXL ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) ). Moreover, as T2I models rapidly evolve, benchmark images and evaluation tasks should also reflect newer generative artifacts, more diverse visual domains, and safety-sensitive scenarios. Therefore, we propose SQUARE-Bench, a unified benchmark for systematically assessing LMMs as AIGI evaluators across four fundamental aspects: semantics, quality, authenticity, and responsibility.
blocks.zh: 评价基准在推动大型多式联运模式的开发方面发挥着关键作用。 以往的基准从COCO Caption(Chen等人,2015年)和GQA(Hudson and Manning,2019年)等特定任务评价演变为MME(Fu等人,2025年),MMBench(Liu等人,2024年b)和MMMU(Yue等人,2024年b)等综合套房,主要侧重于评估LMM在自然影像上的广泛而复杂的推理能力. 最近,如表1所示,在AI生成的图像(AIGIS)领域,已经出现了评估LMM的具体基准. 具体而言,Q-Bench +(Zhang等人,2024c)评估低水平视觉质量;A-Bench(Zhang等人,2024b)针对语义理解和质量感知;而Fake Bench(Li等人,2025b),LOKI(Ye等人,2024b),FakeClue(Wen等人,2025b),和DFbench(Wang等人,2025a)等数据集则侧重于真实性方面(即合成检测). 尽管做出了这些努力,但现有面向AIGI的基准仍然倾向于孤立地评价不同方面,而AIGI评价的系统基准仍然缺乏。 现有作品明显忽略了责任的关键方面,主要依赖过时的T2I模型(例如DALL-E 2 (Ramesh等人,2022年)和SDXL(Rombach等人,2022年))。 此外,随着T2I模型的快速发展,基准图像和评价任务也应反映较新的基因文物、更多样化的视觉领域以及安全敏感的情况。 因此,我们提出SQUARE-Bench,这是在语义、质量、真实性和责任四个基本方面作为AIGI评估者系统评估LMM的统一基准。

blocks.en:
To ensure diverse and rigorous evaluation, we source images from a wide range of T2I models (from legacy to state-of-the-art) to capture various generative flaws. Our curation follows four specific strategies:
1) For semantic understanding , we design content-rich prompts targeting known LMM cognitive bottlenecks ( Figure 2 (a)).
2) For quality perception , we uniformly sample images across a broad spectrum of visual quality distributions ( Figure 3 (a) and (b)).
3) For authenticity identification , we establish a near 1:1 ratio between 3K real photographs and synthetic AIGIs. To prevent trivial detection, the selected AIGIs exhibit high photorealism, with RichHF ( Liang et al., 2024 ) scores uniformly distributed between 0.5 and 1.0 ( Figure 3 (c)).
4) For responsibility detection , we utilize a contrastive pairing strategy: alongside 1.4K unsafe prompts, we curate 0.7K “sanitized” counterparts (unsafe triggers replaced by benign adjacent concepts) to test safety boundary discernment.
Detailed collection procedures are provided in Appendix Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
为了保证多样和严格的评价,我们从广泛的T2I模型(从遗产到最先进的)来源图像,捕捉各种基因缺陷. 我们遵循四项具体战略:
(1) 为了语义理解,我们设计了内容丰富的提示,针对已知的LMM认知瓶颈(图2(a))。
2) 关于质量感知,我们统一对各种视觉质量分布的图像进行抽样(图3(a)和(b))。
3) 为了真实识别,我们在3K真实照片和合成AIGI之间确定了近1:1的比例. 为防止微不足道的探测,选定的AIGIs表现出高度的光现实性,RichHF(Liang等人,2024年)得分统一分布在0.5至1.0之间(图3(c))。
4) 关于责任探测,我们采用对比性配对策略:除了1.4K不安全的提示外,我们还处理0.7K“卫生”对应方(不安全的触发点被良性相邻概念所取代),以测试安全边界识别。

blocks.en: Although our primary focus is assessing LMMs as AIGI evaluators, this evaluation naturally involves two perspectives: what is actually visible in the image and what the original prompt intends the image to contain. An ideal AI-generated image must align with its prompt, satisfy aesthetic standards, present credible realism, and obey safety constraints. Accordingly, an ideal evaluator must master four fundamental aspects: semantic understanding , quality perception , authenticity identification , and responsibility detection . To operationalize these two perspectives within a unified framework, we introduce a Dual-Answer mechanism. For each question, we construct two ground truths: Answer 1 strictly reflects the actual visual content to evaluate the LMM’s pure perception (notably, the LMM is evaluated blindly, without access to the original T2I prompt), whereas Answer 2 describes the expected ideal outcome dictated by the prompt, serving as a baseline for T2I generation capabilities. Section 3.2 provides a concise overview of the four fundamental aspects.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的首要重点是作为AIGI评价员评估LMM,但这一评价自然涉及两个方面:在图像中实际可见的内容和最初的提示意图包含的图像. 一个理想的AI生成的图像必须与其迅速一致,满足审美标准,呈现可信的现实主义,并服从安全限制. 因此,理想的评估人员必须掌握四个基本方面:语义理解、质量感知、真实性识别和责任检测。 为了在统一的框架内落实这两个观点,我们采用了双重答复机制。 对于每个问题,我们构建两个基本真理: 回答1严格反映了评价LMM纯感知的实际视觉内容(尤其是LMM被盲目评价,无法访问原始的T2I快感),而回答2则描述了由快感决定的预期理想结果,作为T2I生成能力的基线. 第3.2节简要概述了四个基本方面。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价分类

blocks.en: SQUARE-Bench covers 38 fine-grained sub-dimensions across four aspects: semantic understanding (scene, object, and text recognition, compositional binding, and knowledge-based reasoning); quality perception (technical degradation, aesthetics, and structural artifacts); authenticity identification (binary, sensory fidelity, geometry, and world-knowledge grounding); and responsibility detection (fairness, harmful content, and safety boundaries). Detailed definitions and supporting references appear in Appendix Appendix A and Appendix B .

blocks.en: 3.3 Question collection
blocks.zh: 3.3 收集问题

blocks.en: SQUARE-Bench adopts five question formats to support both general visual understanding and task-specific diagnosis. The foundational formats include Yes-or-No (36.64%), What (23.94%), and How (7.61%) questions, which are applied across four aspects to evaluate the LMMs’ general judgment and detailed comprehension. Additionally, two specialized formats are introduced for specific diagnostic tasks: binary judgments (31.18%) are exclusively tailored for authenticity identification to distinguish natural from synthetic data, while multi-image questions (120 instances) are specifically designed for social fairness evaluation to assess demographic equity across an image batch.
blocks.zh: SQUARE-Bench采用5个问题格式,既支持一般的视觉理解,也支持针对特定任务的诊断. 基础格式包括“是”或“否”(36.64%)、“什么”(23.94%)和“如何”(7.61%)问题。 这些问题适用于四个方面,用于评估地方政府机制的一般判断和详细理解。 此外,为具体诊断任务采用了两种专门格式:二进制判断(31.18%)专门针对真实性识别,以区分自然数据与合成数据,而多图像问题(120例)专门用于社会公平评价,以评估整个图像批次的人口公平。

blocks.en: To ensure rigorous and reliable evaluation data, we assemble a team of 15 trained human annotators with experience in AIGI evaluation. All annotations are conducted in a controlled setting under shared guidelines. Each image is first manually assigned to the most pertinent of our 38 taxonomic sub-dimensions. For the standard foundational formats , a primary annotator then constructs an instance-specific question, candidate options, and the corresponding dual answers: the Visual GT reflects the observable image content, whereas the Intended GT represents the expected generation outcome under the original prompt and applicable safety requirements. Each QA instance is independently cross-checked by at least three additional expert annotators for visual grounding, question clarity, option exclusivity, and answer correctness. Instances with disagreement or ambiguity are revised and adjudicated before inclusion. For binary judgments , questions and answers are deterministically derived from the ground-truth authenticity labels. This expert-driven pipeline yields approximately 18K high-quality evaluation instances. Comprehensive annotation guidelines and review procedures are provided in Appendix Appendix D .

blocks.en: In this section, we present a comprehensive empirical evaluation based on SQUARE-Bench . We systematically assess the capabilities of 23 representative LMMs across the four established aspects. Furthermore, leveraging the dual-answer design, we derive a text-to-image (T2I) generation baseline, denoted as Mixed-Generator Average , which represents the average generative quality across the evaluated T2I models.

blocks.en: To assess both the innate capabilities and domain learnability of LMMs, we adopt a two-stage evaluation protocol. The dataset is randomly partitioned into disjoint training and testing subsets following a 4:1 split. Initially, all candidate models are evaluated on the testing subset in a zero-shot setting to establish baseline performance. Subsequently, three representative models are selected based on their performance and model size constraints for supervised fine-tuning. All fine-tuned models are implemented in PyTorch and fine-tuned using LoRA on a 48GB NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU. The training process is configured with a batch size of 16 and an initial learning rate of 1 ​ e − 5 1e^{-5} for 3 epochs. All other hyperparameters follow the default settings provided in the official repositories.
blocks.zh: 为了评估LMM的内在能力和域的可学习性,我们通过一个两阶段的评价协议。 数据集在4:1拆分后随机划分为脱节培训和测试子集. 最初,所有候选模型都通过零镜头设定在测试子集上进行评估,以确定基线性能. 随后,根据其性能和模型尺寸限制选择三种代表性模型,用于监督微调. 所有微调模型均在PyTorch实施,并在48GB NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU上使用LORA进行微调. 培训过程配置为批量规模为16个,初步学习率为1 e - 5 1e - 5 = 3个世纪。 所有其他超参数都遵循官方寄存器提供的默认设置.

We report both the best and worst single-expert performances as reference points, with procedural details provided in Appendix Appendix G .

blocks.en: Figure 5 reveals a highly stratified performance landscape. Gemini-3-Pro-Preview achieves the highest overall accuracy and exceeds the best individual-expert reference among the five evaluators, followed closely by Qwen3-VL-32B. However, most evaluated LMMs cluster around 60% accuracy, indicating that strong AIGI-evaluation performance remains concentrated among a few top-performing models. Moreover, performance varies substantially across the four aspects, showing that strong aggregate accuracy does not imply uniformly robust evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图5显示的是高度分层的业绩。 双子座-3-Pro-Preview在5位评价者中达到最高的整体准确度,并超过最佳个人专家参考,紧随其后的是Qune3-VL-32B. 然而,大多数评价的LMM集约60%的准确度,表明AIGI的强评价性能仍然集中在少数顶尖的模型中. 此外,这四个方面的业绩大不相同,表明总体准确性强并不意味着评价一致有力。

blocks.en: Semantics. LMMs show a “coarse-to-fine” performance gap: open-source and proprietary models perform better on basic object recognition than on fine-grained tasks such as counting and composition comprehension ( Table 2 ), suggesting that object recognition does not ensure reliable reasoning over attributes and relations. Quality. Several zero-shot open-source models outperform both the evaluated proprietary models and individual-expert references, particularly in low-level artifact detection and aesthetic assessment ( Table 3 ). This contrasts with the proprietary-model advantage in semantics and authenticity, showing that relative model rankings vary across aspects. Authenticity. Top proprietary models outperform the best individual-expert reference and the evaluated zero-shot open-source models on binary real/fake judgments, but perform less strongly on sensory fidelity inspection and world knowledge grounding ( Table 4 ). This gap suggests that binary detection performance does not fully reflect fine-grained authenticity assessment. Responsibility. Open-source models, proprietary LMMs, and individual human experts perform similarly on explicit harmful content, but less well on politically or culturally sensitive cases ( Table 5 ). This category-level variation may be obscured by aggregate responsibility scores.

blocks.en: By evaluating all four aspects under a shared QA-based framework, taxonomy, model set, and inference protocol, SQUARE-Bench enables controlled cross-aspect profiling. The resulting model rankings provide complementary information: across the 23 zero-shot LMMs, Spearman’s ρ \rho is 0.447 for semantics–quality, 0.362 for quality–authenticity, and 0.296 for quality–responsibility. Substantial rank reversals are also observed: Gemini-3-Pro ranks first in semantics and authenticity but 17th in quality, whereas LLaVA-NeXT ranks fourth in responsibility but 22nd in both semantics and authenticity. These results expose aspect-specific evaluator-selection trade-offs that are difficult to identify from separately constructed leaderboards.

blocks.en: Across the three evaluated models, supervised fine-tuning yields substantial improvements, particularly in quality and authenticity . These gains show that SQUARE-Bench provides learnable supervision for artifact-centric evaluation and that part of the zero-shot performance gap can be reduced through domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 在三个评价模型中,监督的微调产生重大改进,特别是在质量和真实性方面。 这些成果表明,SQUARE-Bench为以文物为中心的评价提供可学习的监督,通过域位调整可以缩小部分零镜头性能差距.

blocks.en: The dual-answer formulation supports complementary diagnostic analyses of T2I generation and LMM evaluation errors. The Mixed-Generator Average achieves an overall success rate of only 26.72%, with substantially higher scores in semantics and responsibility than in quality and authenticity . Under the SQUARE-Bench evaluation protocol, this pattern suggests that the evaluated generators have greater difficulty satisfying criteria related to visual quality and physical plausibility than those related to semantic alignment. Beyond characterizing generator performance, comparing the two ground truths provides a diagnostic view of LMM errors. Across the 23 zero-shot LMMs, average accuracy is 10.37 percentage points lower on cases where the Visual GT differs from the Intended GT, with 17 models exhibiting the same direction of change. Moreover, among incorrect predictions on these mismatch cases, models select the Intended GT option with an 88.64% macro-average probability. Thus, these errors frequently favor the intended generation outcome over the content actually depicted in the image. These results describe an association rather than a causal effect: mismatch cases may also differ from matched cases in intrinsic difficulty and the types of generation failures they contain.
blocks.zh: 双答配方支持T2I生成和LMM评价错误的补充诊断分析. 混合发电机 平均总的成功率只有26.72%,语义和责任方面的得分大大高于质量和真实性。 根据SQUARE-Bench评价协议,这一模式表明,与语义对齐相关的标准相比,被评价的发电机更难以满足视觉质量和物理可靠性标准. 除了描述生成器性能外,比较两个地面的真象可以提供LMM错误的诊断观点. 在23个零射LMM中,视觉GT与意向型GT不同的情况下,平均精度低10.37个百分点,17个型号呈现相同的变化方向. 此外,在对这些不匹配情况的错误预测中,模型以88.64%的宏观平均概率选择了预期GT选项。 因此,这些错误往往有利于预期的生成结果,而不是图像中实际描绘的内容。 这些结果描述了一种关联而不是因果效应:在固有的困难中,不匹配情况也可能与匹配情况不同,它们包含的生成失败类型也不同.

blocks.en: During supervised fine-tuning, both guidance LMMs are conditioned on the image, question, and candidate options and trained to generate the correct option label together with its complete textual content, reinforcing their dimension-specific visual assessment capabilities. Building on these capabilities and the models’ instruction-following ability, we further explore whether their assessment capabilities can be translated into actionable guidance for image refinement.
blocks.zh: 在有监督的微调过程中,两种指导LMM都以图像、问题和候选选项为条件,并接受培训,以生成正确的选项标签及其完整的文字内容,加强它们针对尺寸的视觉评估能力。 基于这些能力和模型的指导能力,我们进一步探讨其评估能力能否转化为改进图像的可操作指南。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 6 , we develop an LMM-guided iterative editing framework. Based on their dimension-specific performance on SQUARE-Bench, we employ LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-8B to guide semantic correction and Ovis2.5-9B to guide quality, authenticity, and responsibility correction. Each guidance LMM is paired with either Qwen-Image-Edit or Step1X-Edit-v1p2 to iteratively assess the updated image and generate editing instructions until the stopping condition is reached. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present SQUARE-Bench , the first comprehensive diagnostic benchmark to systematically evaluate LMMs across four fundamental aspects of AI-generated images: semantics, quality, authenticity , and notably pioneering responsibility . By introducing an innovative dual-answer mechanism, we effectively decouple LMM perceptual errors from inherent T2I generative flaws, moving beyond opaque scoring to diagnose specific cognitive bottlenecks. Empirically, we demonstrate that top-tier LMMs are approaching expert-level performance as AIGI evaluators and can outperform single-expert human references in some settings. However, this excellence is not ubiquitous: the distinct performance stratification and “coarse-to-fine” cognitive degradation indicate that robustness in complex, fine-grained reasoning remains challenging for current LMMs. Furthermore, our extracted T2I baseline exposes a severe gap between semantic texture synthesis and physical realism. As an auxiliary downstream study, we pair dimension-specific LMM guides with fixed image editors in an iterative editing loop. Compared with single-pass editing, the guided system improves selected semantic, authenticity, and responsibility metrics, while consistently underperforming on visual-quality metrics. Overall, SQUARE-Bench provides a diagnostic framework for identifying fine-grained strengths and weaknesses of LMM evaluators, and may serve as a useful diagnostic platform for developing more reliable LMM evaluators and, in turn, for guiding future improvements in text-to-image generation.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了SQUARE-Bench, 这是第一个从人工智能生成的图像的四个基本方面, 即语义、质量、真实性, 通过引入创新的双答机制,我们有效地将LMM感知错误与固有的T2I基因缺陷脱钩,从不透明评分转向诊断特定的认知瓶颈. 从经验上讲,我们证明,顶级的LMM正接近于作为AIGI评估员的专家级业绩,在某些环境中,它能够超越单专家的人类参考资料。 然而,这种优异性并不是无所不在的:明显的性能分层和“粗细”认知退化表明,在复杂、精细的推理中,强健性对于目前的LMM仍然具有挑战性。 此外,我们提取的T2I基线暴露了语义纹理合成与物理现实主义之间的严重差距. 作为辅助的下游研究,我们用一个迭代编辑循环的固定图像编辑器来配对特定维度的LMM指南. 与单通道编辑相比,制导系统改进了选定的语义、真实性和责任度量表,同时在视觉质量度量表上一直表现不佳。 总体而言,SQUARE-Bench为识别LMM评价者的精细优缺点提供了一个诊断框架,并可作为开发更可靠的LMM评价者的有用诊断平台,进而指导今后在文本到图像生成方面的改进。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement

blocks.en: SQUARE-Bench evaluates authenticity and responsibility in AI-generated images and therefore includes safety-sensitive and potentially harmful content. Although these data are intended to support safer and more accountable generative models, exposure to harmful examples and detailed failure analyses may create privacy and dual-use risks, including the possibility of circumventing automated safeguards. To mitigate these risks, we provide content warnings for the responsibility subset, review real-world images for visible personally identifiable information, and obscure identifiable faces in released examples where appropriate. We further plan to distribute the safety-sensitive portion of the benchmark under controlled access and explicit terms of use that prohibit malicious applications. These measures reduce, but cannot fully eliminate, the risks associated with releasing safety-sensitive evaluation data.

blocks.en: C.2 AIGI Collection for Quality Perception

blocks.en: Evaluating the Quality Perception dimension requires AIGIs that span a comprehensive quality spectrum. To accurately mirror real-world variations and avoid distribution collapse, we implement a distribution-aware sampling strategy. For Technical Quality , we source images from the AIGIQA-20K dataset ( Li et al., 2024b ) , applying a uniform sampling strategy based on the provided Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) to ensure an even representation across all quality tiers. For Aesthetic Quality , where native human ratings are absent, we utilize Q-Align ( Wu et al., 2023 ) to infer aesthetic pseudo-labels, followed by similar uniform sampling.
blocks.zh: 评估质量感知维度需要跨全面质量谱的AIGI. 为了准确反映现实世界的变异,避免分配崩溃,我们实施一种认识到分配的取样策略. 就技术质量而言,我们从AIGIQA-20K数据集(Li等人,2024年b)中获取图像,采用基于所提供的 " 平均意见分数 " (MOS)的统一取样战略,以确保在所有质量级别上均匀的表示。 对于"美学质量",没有本土人类评分的地方,我们利用Q-Align(Wu等人,2023年)推断美学伪标签,然后进行类似的统一采样.

blocks.en: For Generative Distortion , we manually curate AIGIs exhibiting characteristic generative flaws. However, to ensure our benchmark remains highly relevant and is not constrained by the limitations of legacy datasets, we augment this foundational pool with approximately 500 newly synthesized AIGIs. Detailed in Section C.1 , these novel images are designed to capture the emerging artifacts of contemporary SOTA T2I models. We strictly enforce a mutually exclusive curation process to guarantee zero content overlap across the entire quality subset.

blocks.en: Building upon these meticulous dimension-specific collection strategies, the finalized SQUARE-Bench encompasses an unprecedented breadth of visual data. Beyond the rigorously controlled, uniform quality distribution discussed above, the consolidated AIGI corpus introduces highly diverse stylistic paradigms and a comprehensive array of semantic categories. As showcased in Figure 7 through Figure 10 , the dataset covers a continuum of generative scenarios—ranging from ultra-photorealistic portraits to complex, abstract artistic compositions. blocks.en: Appendix D Expert-Driven QA Construction
blocks.zh: 附录D 专家驱动QA建筑

blocks.en: D.1 Construction and Review Protocol
blocks.zh: D.1 建造和审查议定书

blocks.en: To transform the curated image collection into a rigorous evaluation benchmark, we adopt a fully expert-driven workflow consisting of fine-grained dimension alignment, manual QA authoring, independent cross-checking, and final adjudication.
blocks.zh: 为了把整理的图像收集转化为严格的评价基准,我们采用了完全由专家驱动的工作流程,包括精细的尺寸调整、人工质量评估的编写、独立的交叉核对和最后裁定。

blocks.en: Images may exhibit multiple potential issues ( e.g. , both lighting inconsistency and anatomical deformation). To maintain a clear evaluation target, annotators first map each image to the single most salient sub-dimension among the 38 categories in our taxonomy. The selected sub-dimension determines the primary capability assessed by the subsequent question, preventing individual instances from conflating unrelated visual properties.
blocks.zh: 图像可能显示出多种潜在问题(例如,照明不一致和解剖变形)。 为了保持一个明确的评价目标,注释者首先将每个图像映射到我们分类学中38个类别中最突出的单一子分支。 所选择的子分解决定了后续问题所评估的主要能力,防止了单个实例对不相关的视觉属性进行拼凑.

blocks.en: For each assigned image, a human annotator examines the image, its source prompt when available, and the definition of the target sub-dimension. The annotator then manually constructs an instance-specific question, a set of candidate options, and the corresponding dual answers. The Visual GT is determined exclusively from observable image content, whereas the Intended GT represents the expected generation outcome under the original prompt and applicable safety requirements.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个指定图像,一个人类注释者检查图像,其来源在可用时的提示,以及目标子化的定义. 注释员然后手动构建一个实例特定的问题,一组候选选项,以及相应的双重答案. 视觉GT完全根据可观察到的图像内容确定,而意向GT则代表了最初的即时适用安全要求下的预期生成结果.

blocks.en: All annotators follow a shared set of construction guidelines:
blocks.zh: 所有注释者都遵循一套共同的建筑准则:

blocks.en: Figure 11: User Interface demonstrating the Fine-Grained Dimension Alignment process.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Illustration of the manual QA authoring interface. Experts are shown the assigned sub-dimension and record an instance-specific question, candidate options, and the corresponding Visual and Intended Ground Truth answers.
blocks.zh: 图12:人工QA编写界面图解. 专家被显示分配的子分区,并记录一个具体实例问题、候选选项以及相应的视觉和意向地面真相答案。

blocks.en: • Dimension fidelity: Each question must primarily assess the assigned sub-dimension rather than an unrelated visual property. • Visual grounding: The correct Visual GT must be supported by observable evidence in the image. Questions answerable solely from commonsense or textual priors are excluded. • Instance specificity: Questions must refer to the distinctive content of the given image rather than use generic templates such as “Is this image high quality?” • Diagnostic value: Questions should expose meaningful perceptual or reasoning failures while avoiding unnecessarily trivial cues, unless those cues are themselves the target of the assigned sub-dimension. • Option validity: Candidate options must be plausible, mutually exclusive, and sufficiently complete to contain an unambiguous correct answer. • Dual-answer consistency: The Visual GT and Intended GT must respectively reflect the rendered image and the intended generation target, without conflating perception errors with generation failures.
blocks.zh: • 忠诚程度: 每个问题必须首先评估所分配的分层,而不是一个无关的视觉属性。 • 支助 视觉地面: 正确的Visual GT必须得到图像中可观察到的证据的支持. 仅从常识或文字前科中解答的问题不在此列。 • 支助 实例特异性:问题必须提及给定图像的独特内容,而不是使用诸如“这种图像是否质量高?” 等通用模板。 • 诊断价值: 问题应揭露有意义的观念或推理失败,同时避免不必要的小提示,除非这些提示本身是指定子提示的目标。 • 备选办法有效性: 候选选项必须合理、相互排斥,并足够完整,以包含一个明确无误的正确答案。 • 双重回答的一致性: Visual GT和Integrated GT必须分别反映渲染的图像和预期的生成目标,而不将感知错误与生成失败混为一谈.

blocks.en: Dimension fidelity: Each question must primarily assess the assigned sub-dimension rather than an unrelated visual property.
blocks.zh: 维度忠诚度 : 每个问题必须首先评估所分配的分层,而不是一个无关的视觉属性。

blocks.en: Visual grounding: The correct Visual GT must be supported by observable evidence in the image. Questions answerable solely from commonsense or textual priors are excluded.
blocks.zh: 视觉地面: 正确的Visual GT必须得到图像中可观察到的证据的支持. 仅从常识或文字前科中解答的问题不在此列。

blocks.en: Instance specificity: Questions must refer to the distinctive content of the given image rather than use generic templates such as “Is this image high quality?”
blocks.zh: 实例特异性 : 问题必须提及给定图像的独特内容,而不是使用诸如“这种图像质量高吗? “

blocks.en: Diagnostic value: Questions should expose meaningful perceptual or reasoning failures while avoiding unnecessarily trivial cues, unless those cues are themselves the target of the assigned sub-dimension.
blocks.zh: 诊断值 : 问题应揭露有意义的观念或推理失败,同时避免不必要的小提示,除非这些提示本身是指定子提示的目标。

blocks.en: Option validity: Candidate options must be plausible, mutually exclusive, and sufficiently complete to contain an unambiguous correct answer.
blocks.zh: 选项有效性 : 候选选项必须合理、相互排斥,并足够完整,以包含一个明确无误的正确答案。

blocks.en: Dual-answer consistency: The Visual GT and Intended GT must respectively reflect the rendered image and the intended generation target, without conflating perception errors with generation failures.
blocks.zh: 双答一致性 : Visual GT和Integrated GT必须分别反映渲染的图像和预期的生成目标,而不将感知错误与生成失败混为一谈.

blocks.en: Each completed QA instance is independently reviewed by at least three additional expert annotators. Reviewers verify the question premise, visual grounding, sub-dimension alignment, option exclusivity, and correctness of both ground-truth answers. They also identify cases in which blur, occlusion, or insufficient visual evidence prevents a decisive answer. Any instance that fails one or more checks is returned for revision. Remaining disagreements are discussed and adjudicated by the annotation team before the instance is accepted into the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 每个已完成的质量保证实例至少由另外三名专家注释员独立审查。 审查者核实问题前提、目视定位、分解调整、选项排他性以及两个地面真实答案的正确性。 他们还查明了模糊、隐蔽或视觉证据不足从而无法作出决定性答复的情况。 任何一次或多次检查失败的事例都会退回修订。 余下的分歧由注释小组讨论和裁决,然后才将案件纳入基准。

blocks.en: For the standard foundational formats, including Yes-or-No, What, and How questions, annotators manually construct the complete question-option-answer tuple. Binary real/fake judgments are deterministically derived from the ground-truth authenticity labels. This workflow produces approximately 18K human-constructed and cross-checked evaluation instances.
blocks.zh: 对于标准的基础格式,包括 " 是-或-否 " 、 " 是什么 " 和 " 如何问题 " 等,注释者手动构建完整的问题-选项-答题图案。 二进制真实/假判断由地面真实性标签决定。 这一工作流程产生了大约18K个由人构建和交叉检查的评价实例。

blocks.en: D.2 Human Expert Annotation
blocks.zh: D.2 人权专家说明

blocks.en: We recruit 15 human experts with professional experience in photography, AI-generated images, and visual-quality evaluation. All annotation sessions are conducted in a controlled laboratory environment under standard indoor lighting. Images and annotation interfaces are displayed on a 4K monitor with a resolution of 3840 × 2160 3840\times 2160 . Annotators are compensated at approximately $10 per hour, with a total annotation cost of approximately $15,000. To mitigate fatigue and maintain annotation quality, each expert processes no more than 30 images per day.

blocks.en: We use standardized QA instruction templates across all candidate LMMs to reduce parsing ambiguity and encourage uniformly formatted outputs. All models are evaluated with a decoding temperature of 0 (greedy decoding) to minimize sampling-related variation and improve reproducibility. This setting reduces stochastic decoding effects but does not eliminate implementation- or response-format-related variation; invalid and non-parseable responses are handled as described below.

blocks.en: For the multi-image Cultural Fairness and Human Bias questions, an empty or non-parseable response is counted as incorrect. Because the random-guessing baseline assumes that a valid option is produced for every question, a score of 0.00% or below this baseline may reflect a low valid-response rate rather than systematic selection of incorrect options. DeepSeek-VL-7B-Chat had no valid parsed prediction for any of the 6 Cultural Fairness questions or any of the 12 Human Bias questions. DeepSeek-VL2-small likewise had no valid parsed prediction for any of the 12 Human Bias questions. For Cultural Fairness, however, DeepSeek-VL2-small returned valid options for only 2 of 6 questions and answered 1 correctly, yielding an overall accuracy of 16.67%. Given the small subset sizes (6 and 12 test QAs), these results should be interpreted cautiously rather than as stable estimates of model performance.

Colored speckles and block-like artifacts become visible at the

and fragmented edges across the face, hair, and green background.
Thus, an early improvement in apparent clarity does not necessarily
translate into sustained visual quality over additional iterations.

blocks.en:
These trajectories illustrate a potential tension between correcting
a diagnosed defect and preserving image fidelity. Although the editing
instructions seek to correct hand structure or improve image clarity,
later outputs exhibit degradation beyond the intended corrections.
Because each output becomes the input to the next iteration, newly
introduced artifacts can persist or become more pronounced in
subsequent outputs. This observation motivates quality-aware stopping
criteria and mechanisms for retaining an earlier, higher-quality
intermediate result.
